Jenna: Quick heads up — I'm blocking Saturday morning (UTC) for family stuff. Primary for tomorrow morning currently listed as Priya. I won't be able to cover 06:00–14:00 UTC. Can someone pick up primary for that window? We had a few intermittent latency spikes on inference-hosts2 last night (~03:20 UTC), not full outage but noticed more 5xx/timeout pages. No customer severity yet but we should watch.

Priya: Thanks for the ping. I'm primary now until 06:00 UTC. Can't extend that block because of calls. If someone can take 06–14 UTC, please confirm — need both primary + secondary (handshake) for the overlap. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference-high-latency

Carlos: I can take primary 06–14 UTC. I'll be in EU timezone then. Will be on phone. Can someone be secondary 10–18 UTC to cover the tail?

Omar: I can be secondary 10–18 UTC (happy to jump earlier if needed). Adding myself to PagerDuty for that window.

incident-bot: ALERT created: INC-2026-8743 — inference-hosts2 high p95 latency (>1s) — triggered 2026-02-11T03:20:12Z — paging frequency: 5m

Li: Quick note on mitigation steps from runbook: 1) check runtime pod CPU/IO 2) clear prefix cache for affected model 3) if sustained, route traffic to fallback smaller-quantized model (fallback-policy in console). Example commands:
```
kubectl get pods -n inference -l app=runtime
kubectl exec -n inference runtime-pod -- /bin/sh -c 'tail -n 200 /var/log/runtime.log'
redwood-cli route set --model-id rdw/falcon-fallback --from inference-service-1
```

Carlos: Got it. If I get multiple pages I'll start with pod CPU/IO and cache clear. If >2 pages in 10m I'll trigger fallback. @Omar please be ready to run the route command if I lose SSH.

Omar: copy that. I'll also leave my phone ringer on. If I don't respond within 3m, escalate to Li.

Priya: Thanks folks. Quick handoff checklist:
- who's primary: Carlos (06–14 UTC)
- who's secondary: Omar (10–18 UTC)
- backup: Li
- customer impact: potential latency degrade for a small subset, no 503s observed in last 12h
- runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference-high-latency
- PD incident: INC-2026-8743 (keep notes in the incident channel)

Carlos: :thumbsup: I'll post a short status update in #incidents if I see anything >2 pages. Otherwise will hand off to Omar at 14:00 UTC and leave a brief note here.

Jenna: Thanks everyone — appreciate the coverage. If anyone needs credentials or short access, DM me before 05:45 UTC.

Priya: Adding final reminder — mark the shift in the oncall spreadsheet (shared drive) and update PD acknowledgment when you pick up.

Carlos: Acknowledged. I'll mark it and add my phone number in the PD notes.

Priya: Confirmed handoff at 06:00 UTC. Closing this thread for followups — please open a new thread if an active incident spins up.
